title: Psychological and behavioural responses in human-agent vs. human-human interactions: a systematic review and meta-analysis
reasoning: The paper includes 'Prosociality and morality' as one of its six main response themes. It specifically meta-analyzes 'moral engagement', defined as the psychological and behavioural commitment to moral standards in a given context, which is a core component of evaluating ethics and moral behavior in human-agent interactions.
